finalText:
Migration complete — 12 files, 36 call sites moved to `db.execute({ sql, params })`:

| Area | Files |
|---|---|
| admin | `accounts/apiKeyAdmin.js`, `support/macroAdmin.js`, `catalog/variantAdmin.js` |
| service | `accounts/teamService.js`, `billing/couponService.js`, `orders/returnService.js` |
| repo | `accounts/session.js`, `support/sla.js`, `analytics/cohort.js`, `billing/refund.js`, `orders/shipment.js`, `catalog/supplier.js` |

Two things I deliberately left alone:

- **`vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js` (2 call sites)** — the file's header says it's a vendored copy replaced wholesale on upgrade and that local edits are silently lost. Editing it would break on the next `legacy-orm` bump. It needs either an upstream fix or a wrapper on our side; your call which.
- **`cache.query(...)`** — that's the cache handle, not `db`, and unrelated to this deprecation.

`lib/db.js` still exports `query` (marked `@deprecated`); it can be deleted once the vendor call sites are resolved. No tests found in the repo, so nothing was run to verify.
